data.raw_text:
Caroline Graham’s response doesn’t feel like a clarification, it feels like a clap back to people questioning her role in this latest circus.

She says she and Thomas Markle met “through work” and bonded quickly. Fine, but that matters when she’s previously been linked to coverage around the staged DM leak before the wedding that allegedly destroyed Seniors relationship with Meghan.

Then there’s the travel story. She claims she rushed from LA to the Philippines via South Korea and spent two days at his bedside in a Cebu ICU. But if that’s true… how was a detailed piece already written from the Philippines on December 3?  The timeline just doesn’t add up.

And does no one find it strange how fast the media seemed to be looped in while he was supposedly being rushed into surgery? 

In a real medical emergency, most families aren’t calling newspapers to disclose the personal health details of someone who is under the knife.  I would think the  DM would have had to have permission from Senior himself to run the initial story published by DM on December 3rd.

There would be some coordination here with TM Junior that would take a little bit of time before execution, especially if Caroline Graham was dropping everything in LA to be by Senior's bedside 22hrs later.  

That’s what makes this whole thing feel off. A serious health situation instantly becomes a highly emotional, global media story, just in time to overshadow Catherine's Carol service. It is my opinion, but that doesn’t happen by accident.

Also, notice how selective the outrage is. Everyone’s happy to pile on Meghan, but where’s the same energy for Doria? Where is she? Why is that never questioned? 

Nothing about this feels straightforward, just like all the  other Markle crisis leaving us in a cognitive fog.
The uncertainty increases emotional engagement bringing out rage in some.  Is that all by design? 
When  you have people stuck in emotional speculation, easier to distract and influence. 

And one last thing worth thinking about: why would the Royals, or even Prince Harry, not ever signal a sign of sympathy toward Thomas Markle Sr., even now when he was allegedly close to near death?
